studies.finding: Macrophages localized around degenerate lipid droplets, and crown-like structures associated with enlarged adipocytes; some lean/obese individuals contradicted a simple BMI-only classification.
limitations: Selected primary publisher Results, Figure 3 caption and Discussion excerpts were read. Complete Methods, whole-article PDF, raw images and supplementary material were not read. No intervention causing human adipocyte death, transport barrier or tissue-wide hysteresis is inferred.
Static histology does not prove that macrophages cause death, that transport barriers stabilize niches, or how/when lipid-laden syncytia are cleared.
Full Methods and quantitative raw image reanalysis remain unread.
Primary-source interpretation only: no raw-data replay, laboratory reproduction, independent scientific review, universal causal weight, minimal organism or numerical construction rule is admitted.
studies.observable: Crown-like structures, adipocyte size, perilipin loss and electron-microscopic morphology
studies.preparation: The read Figure 3/Results compare MAC-2-positive cell localization with perilipin-negative adipocytes and ultrastructural features in biopsies spanning BMI 20–45. Full sampling Methods were not read.
